title: Incident Investigation Report
subtitle: Report IR 2026 07. Minor injury at the guillotine, Hofsanger Sheet Metal Works, Rosslyn

rows: Cutting bay, hydraulic guillotine G2, Rosslyn factory (fictitious)
Machine operator, employee number HSM 0318 (name held by HR)

Treated by the company's appointed doctor the same day; outcome **fit**, returned to normal duties on 17 March 2026. No clinical detail is kept in this File; the medical record stays with the occupational health practitioner
Karabo Mothibi, Production Manager (lead); Grace Naidoo, Health and Safety Officer; Elias Maluleke, health and safety representative, cutting bay

blocks.p: The operator was removing an offcut from the back of guillotine G2 while the machine was switched on. The rear guard had been left open after a blade change that morning. The operator's hand came into contact with the sharp edge of the offcut as the back gauge moved. First aid was given at once by the bay first aider, and the operator was taken to the doctor.
The team used the five whys method, with the operator, the maintenance fitter and the supervisor interviewed on 17 March 2026.

rows: Hand reached into the rear of the machine while it was live and the back gauge moved
The rear guard was open; its interlock had been bypassed with a cable tie during the blade change
The blade change was done without a lockout, so nothing prompted a check that the guard was closed and the interlock restored
The guillotine blade change procedure did not require a guard and interlock check before hand back, and the pre use checklist did not include the rear guard
Remove the cable tie; test the rear guard interlock; guillotine back in use only after the test
Revise the blade change procedure: lockout, guard and interlock test before hand back, signed by the fitter and the operator
Add the rear guard and interlock to the daily pre use checklist for G1 and G2
Toolbox talk to all cutting bay operators and fitters on guards, interlocks and lockout; attendance register filed in Section D
Check all other machines for bypassed interlocks and record the result in the Section F register
Closed 10/04/2026; one bypass found on press P4 and removed
Employer's report of an accident submitted to the Compensation Fund on 18/03/2026; acknowledgement and claim reference held by HR
Inspector of the Department of Employment and Labour
Not reported: the registered practitioner checked the event against the OHS Act reporting criteria on 17/03/2026 and it did not meet them. Her note is filed with this report
Tabled at the meeting of 09/04/2026; actions accepted
